faq.question: Q1. What is UCSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: UCSL Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment notification issued by Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited to fill 2 Supervisory posts (Supervisor Nesting and Supervisor Mechanical) on a regular roll.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UCSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies: 1 for Supervisor (Nesting) and 1 for Supervisor (Mechanical).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for UCSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Supervisor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a three-year Diploma in relevant engineering branches (Mechanical, Electrical, Marine, Civil, Electronics & Communication, Computer, or Automobile Engineering) from a State Board of Technical Education, along with required post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UCSL Supervisor recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on 28 October 2026, with age relaxation applicable for ST candidates and Ex-servicemen as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UCSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹400/- for Unreserved candidates, while SC and ST candidates are exempted from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for UCSL Supervisor posts?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official portals at www.cochinshipyard.in or www.udupicsl.com between 07 October 2026 and 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for UCSL Supervisor posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises Phase I (an offline written test with an Objective Type Test of 40 marks and a Descriptive Type Test of 40 marks) and Phase II (a Power Point presentation on work experience for 20 marks).

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for UCSL Supervisor posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates are placed in the S1 Grade pay scale of ₹28000-3%-110000, with total monthly emoluments amounting to approximately ₹56,896 including DA, HRA, and perks/allowances.
